long_biography.plain_text:
Temenos grew from a small specialist into a global banking-software supplier during Andreas Andreades’s leadership. Trained as an engineer at Cambridge and later qualified as a chartered accountant, he worked for KPMG and PepsiCo before joining the Geneva company. He eventually combined executive responsibility with chairmanship, giving its international expansion unusually sustained oversight.

His tenure encompassed the expansion of Temenos to thousands of clients worldwide and its shift towards recurring software revenue. After stepping back from day-to-day management, Andreades returned as chief executive during a leadership transition and retired after his successor was appointed. That final handover capped a career closely associated with scaling Swiss banking technology internationally.
